parameters.content:
## 🌸 LouLou & Luxe — Public Launching Soon vs `sbanerjee.cloud` Development Branch
- **Public Website (`https://loulouandluxe.com`):** Displays ONLY the **Launching Soon / Coming Soon** page.
- **Development & Testing Branch (`http://localhost:11434`):** Hosts the full interactive Storefront.
- **1-Time-Per-User Cookie Consent:** Stored in `localStorage` + `document.cookie` (365d) + PostgreSQL `loulou_cookie_consents`.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key VARCHAR(320) PRIMARY KEY,
  consent_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALL',
  necessary_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  analytics_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  marketing_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  policy_version VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'v1.0-2026-10',
  region_code VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'US',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key, consent_level, necessary_cookies, analytics_cookies, marketing_cookies, policy_version, region_code, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.visitorKey }}',
  '{{ $json.consent_level }}',
  TRUE,
  {{ $json.analytics_cookies }},
  {{ $json.marketing_cookies }},
  '{{ $json.policy_version }}',
  '{{ $json.region_code }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (visitor_key) DO UPDATE SET
  consent_level = EXCLUDED.consent_level,
  analytics_cookies = EXCLUDED.analytics_cookies,
  marketing_cookies = EXCLUDED.marketing_cookies,
  updated_at = NOW();

SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  'CONSENT_RECORDED' AS status,
  '{{ $json.consent_level }}' AS consent_level,
  {{ $json.analytics_cookies }} AS analytics_cookies,
  {{ $json.marketing_cookies }} AS marketing_cookies;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key VARCHAR(320) PRIMARY KEY,
  consent_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALL',
  necessary_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  analytics_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  marketing_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  policy_version VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'v1.0-2026-10',
  region_code VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'US',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}') AS "alreadyConsented",
  COALESCE((SELECT consent_level FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), 'ALL') AS consent_level,
  COALESCE((SELECT analytics_cookies FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), TRUE) AS analytics_cookies,
  COALESCE((SELECT marketing_cookies FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), TRUE) AS marketing_cookies;

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 15, 2026  |  Organization: LouLou & Luxe / MultiWebsite Hub Analytics (sbanerjee.cloud & loulouandluxe.com)

LouLou & Luxe and MultiWebsite Hub Analytics ("we," "our," or "us") respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any information collected or processed through our websites (loulouandluxe.com, sbanerjee.cloud) and our internal market-research and e-commerce analytics applications.

1. Information We Collect & Process

  • Publicly Available Market & Trend Data: Our analytics application accesses aggregated, non-personal public trend metrics, boards, pins, and product listings via official platform APIs (including the Pinterest API v5, Etsy API v3, and Google Trends) strictly for internal trend research, design inspiration, and merchandising analysis.
  • Storefront Visitor Data: When you visit our storefronts or opt into our newsletter, we may collect your email address (only when voluntarily submitted), cookie consent preferences, and anonymized technical logs (browser type, IP region, and timestamps).
  • Account Authentication (Internal Users Only): When authorized team members connect a third-party developer account (such as Pinterest Business or Etsy), we store OAuth access tokens securely in encrypted server-side storage solely to perform authorized read/analytics operations.

2. How We Use Information (Including Pinterest API Data)

  • To identify seasonal fashion, home decor, and gift trends for our internal product design pipeline.
  • To manage and analyze our own brand boards, pins, and catalog listings in full compliance with the Pinterest Developer Guidelines and Terms of Service.
  • We never sell, rent, license, or share Pinterest user data, OAuth tokens, or visitor data with third parties or data brokers.
  • We do not scrape private user profiles or store personally identifiable information (PII) of third-party platform users.

3. Data Storage, Security & Retention

All application data and API credentials are stored in access-controlled, encrypted cloud databases with strict Row-Level Security (RLS). Aggregated trend snapshots are retained only as long as necessary for seasonal merchandising analysis, and any connected OAuth tokens or stored data are immediately revoked and deleted upon request.

4. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use essential cookies to remember visitor consent preferences and maintain session security. You may manage or revoke your cookie preferences at any time on our website.

5. Your Privacy Rights (GDPR / CCPA)

Depending on your jurisdiction, you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal information we hold about you. To exercise these rights or request immediate data deletion, please contact us at the email address below.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact our Privacy Officer at:
Email: user@example.com
Websites: https://loulouandluxe.com & http://localhost:11434/webhook/privacy-policy
